description: GPT-6 Sol is OpenAI's reasoning model for complex coding and agentic workflows. It accepts text and images, generates text, and supports a 1,050,000-token context window with up to 128,000 output tokens. Configurable reasoning effort, structured outputs, prompt caching, and Responses API tools make it suited to software development and multi-step automation.
name: OpenAI: GPT-6 Sol (Fast)
